title: Windows B runner proof: the complete Engram gate on master 7d6710cf
outcome: Windows B runs Engram's complete standard full gate on published master 7d6710cfec40c98d68088c6dd0f38b84023b2a72 and returns verifiable evidence, proving it as a remote runner for Engram.
acceptance: Windows B fetched origin master commit 7d6710cfec40c98d68088c6dd0f38b84023b2a72, tree 52f8f205d9e6b674ae1f552ff52d724dd39d2aed, into a fresh clone and worktree whose index and tracked files equal that commit, with no untracked files; the commit id, tree id and the review-freeze fingerprint before and after the run are recorded on this item

The standard launcher `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full` ran there with cargo 1.98.1 (797e8a9bc) shown in its preflight log, and its results show expected = before = after; the result of every stage is recorded on this item, with bounded failure evidence for any stage that failed
The run is recorded as evidence only: it does not count as a landing gate, and nothing was pushed from Windows B

completion.summary: Windows B runner proof completed: standard full gate passed all 12 stages on published Engram 7d6710cfec40c98d68088c6dd0f38b84023b2a72 with Cargo 1.98.1, exact commit/tree and matching before/after freeze. The first run's 266-character fixture-path failure was diagnosed and corrected using a shorter fresh worktree without source or test changes. Evidence only; no push or landing credit. Independent evaluation f362f2ad43184cdc96d172c86ab20dd6 passed all 3 criteria.
